name: modular-studio
description: Plataforma de diseño, despiece, presupuesto y fabricación de muebles modulares (es-MX, mm, MXN).

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @ms/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run e2e
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build:firebase && npx -y firebase-tools@15.35.0 deploy --only hosting,firestore
scripts.build:firebase:emulator: BUILD_TARGET=firebase NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY=demo-key NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-modular-studio NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=localhost NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID=demo NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1 npm run build -w @ms/web
